identity.name: Pectin (including amidated pectin)
identity.chemical_class: Plant-derived complex polysaccharides (partially methylated polygalacturonic acids and related salts/amides)

function.mechanism: Hydrated pectin chains increase viscosity and form gel networks, stabilizing dispersed food systems.

adi.basis: ADI not specified; EFSA concluded no numerical ADI needed for the general population (2017), with infant-specific caveats in 2021 follow-up.

efsa.key_finding: EFSA found no safety concern for general population use, but for infants below 16 weeks some scenarios had margin of safety <1 at MPLs and methanol-related concern, leading to recommendation to reduce MPLs in infant categories.

adi.basis: ADI not specified (group ADI for pectins and amidated pectins).

concerns.summary: Infant-specific high exposure scenarios are the main concern: EFSA (2021) reported margin of safety below 1 in some infant scenarios at MPLs and possible adverse methanol internal dose; JECFA (2014) considered 0.5% use in infant formula of concern.
Dose-response effects were seen in neonatal pigs at 1% pectin (reduced growth/feed intake/digestibility), while 0.2% was reported safe and well tolerated.

no_concern_confirmed: EFSA 2017 concluded no safety concern for general population and no need for a numerical ADI.
JECFA record lists ADI as not specified and 2016 infant-related reassessment concluded low risk at 0.2% use in formula.
No IARC Monographs classification entry for pectin/pectins was found in the current agent list data.

populations: Infants below 16 weeks consuming formula at high/additive-maximum permitted levels
adi_exceedance.notes: Classical ADI exceedance is less applicable because ADI is not specified; concern is scenario-specific margin of safety and methanol exposure in young infants.

risk_assessment.rationale: General-population evidence supports safety at regulated uses, but repeated regulatory caveats for infant formula high-exposure scenarios prevent a lower-risk classification.
key_factors: EFSA 2017: no safety concern for general population; no numerical ADI needed
EFSA 2021: infant <16 weeks scenarios with margin of safety <1 and methanol concern at MPLs
JECFA 2014/2016 infant assessments show concern at higher level and low risk at 0.2%
FDA CFR: GRAS with GMP-limited use conditions
